main_body: A flat repeating grass ground patch (64x48) in three greens with dark clumps and a few light tufts; it is terrain, not a standing object.
top_band: none; the column scan shows only repeating grass texture runs (L=81/106/135) with no top band or front face, as expected for ground terrain
evidence: Ground texture tile with no standing volume. The 3/4 top/front contract does not apply to terrain, so there is no violation: no side faces, no elevation, no plan slab of an object.

style.evidence: The candidate has only 3 distinct colours, with a median of 3 per tile, against 26 per tile and 80 colours for the reference grass. 5x5 flat-fill coverage is 30% against 0% for the grass. The base is one flat mid green, with a repeated stamp of dark clump blobs and a few single-pixel highlights. It is a regular tiled pattern, with no grain or multi-tone clumps. It is much thinner than the Beodeul grass reference, which has several greens, tufts and soil grain. There is no outline to judge.
